newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM to invest FIM 180 mln at Jamsankoski.
newsitem.headline: UPM to invest FIM 180 mln at Jamsankoski.

text.p: Europe's biggest forestry group UPM-Kymmene plans to invest 180 million markka to renovate an adhesive label paper machine at its Jamsankoski mill, the company said in a statement received on Monday.

"The 180 million markka investment will raise the capacity of paper machine 3 by around 20,000 tonnes per year. At the same time, (it) will be equipped to manufacture ever more demanding face and release paper for self-adhesive labels," it said.
The machine, built in 1960, now has a production capacity of 65,000 tonnes per year, it said.
The renovation work is scheduled to start in early 1998, and is expected to shut down the machine for six weeks, a UPM-Kymmene spokesman said by telephone.
